Use cases
Deploy Into Every Part Of The
Development Lifecycle
With Hoplite, automate everything from issue triage to complex migrations.
Instant issue resolution
Spin up threads as soon as new Sentry issues are created, and merge before they become real production incidents.
One-click share links mean threads can be easily handed off between engineers and stakeholders.
With deep integrations into Linear and Slack, you can spin up and monitor threads from your existing preferred tools. The agent picks up the context and gets to work.
Every pull request gets a full video walk through of the user flow -- before and after the change. Verify without needing to manually step through everything.
